title: A counit-preserving ordinary-etale realization of the intrinsic exceptional adjunction
statement: In the standing finite-type separated field setting [sk-def-sfb-dc-setting], fix the open/proper compactification j,p and a finite commutative ell-primary coefficient ring A. If its intrinsic compact-support functor preserves Dctf, there are a right functor G on intrinsic Dctf and an adjunction F_A ⊣ G, together with ReductionExceptionalRealization [def-sp-reduction-exceptional-realization-objects]. In particular the ordinary origins are bounded constructible of finite Tor amplitude, the output isomorphism is natural, and it satisfies the actual transported counit equation.

proof.text: Use the proved ReductionDirectImage realization lemmas to identify intrinsic Dctf with fixed-module bounded constructible finite-Tor complexes. Restrict the actual reductionSite functor to the ordinary and intrinsic full Dctf subcategories. Bounded-below comparison Hom bijectivity gives full faithfulness. For essential surjectivity, realize an intrinsic object inversely, take its bounded constructible etale origin, and reflect its Tor interval by the source HomComparison theorem torAmplitudeIn_mapDerivedCategory_iff. Its realization and equivalence counit give the required intrinsic isomorphism. This directly proves siteCtf_equivalence without passing through coefficient-sized site models.

The field and finite-type assumptions make X, Y and Z Noetherian; the finite ell-primary ring has invertible exponent on Y. Take the ordinary exceptional adjoint of the chosen default compact-support functor, and use rightDerivedLowerShriekIso to obtain an adjunction for the given compactification j,p. The ordinary-etale finite-ring preservation APIs constructibleFiniteTor_rightDerivedLowerShriek and constructibleFiniteTor_rightDerivedUpperShriek restrict this adjunction to the ordinary full Dctf categories using Adjunction.restrictFullyFaithful. The counit of this restriction maps to the original ordinary counit.

Lift reductionSiteCompactSupportIso through the fully faithful intrinsic inclusion to a left comparison between the two restricted functors. Compose the restricted adjunction with the inverse source comparison equivalence and target comparison equivalence, and apply ofNatIsoLeft using this lifted comparison. The right functor is target inverse, restricted ordinary right adjoint, then source comparison. Choose the target inverse as the origin, its equivalence counit as originIso, and the definitionally identical composite as rightIso.

Expand the counit of the composed adjunction and ofNatIsoLeft in the private realizationAdjunction_counit lemma. Move the inverse source-equivalence unit using naturality of the lifted left comparison; its composite with the inverse counit is the identity by the equivalence triangle law. Apply the intrinsic inclusion to this formula. The fully faithful preimage equation identifies the left comparison with reductionSiteCompactSupportIso, while map_restrictFullyFaithful_counit_app identifies the restricted counit with the ordinary counit. The identity output comparison contributes an identity morphism, so the resulting formula is exactly reductionRealizationCounitEquation.

theorem reductionExceptionalRealization_exists
    (ℓ pchar : ℕ) [Fact ℓ.Prime] (_hp : 0 < pchar) (hℓ : pchar ≠ ℓ)
    (k : Type u) [Field k] [CharP k pchar]
    {X Z Y : Scheme.{u}}
    [X.Over (Spec (.of k))] [Z.Over (Spec (.of k))] [Y.Over (Spec (.of k))]
    [LocallyOfFiniteType (X ↘ Spec (.of k))] [QuasiCompact (X ↘ Spec (.of k))]
    [IsSeparated (X ↘ Spec (.of k))]
    [LocallyOfFiniteType (Z ↘ Spec (.of k))] [QuasiCompact (Z ↘ Spec (.of k))]
    [IsSeparated (Z ↘ Spec (.of k))]
    [LocallyOfFiniteType (Y ↘ Spec (.of k))] [QuasiCompact (Y ↘ Spec (.of k))]
    [IsSeparated (Y ↘ Spec (.of k))]
    (f : X ⟶ Y) [f.IsOver (Spec (.of k))]
    (j : X ⟶ Z) [IsOpenImmersion j] [j.IsOver (Spec (.of k))]
    (p : Z ⟶ Y) [IsProper p] [p.IsOver (Spec (.of k))] (_hf : j ≫ p = f)
    (A : Type u) [CommRing A] [Finite A]
    (hA : ∃ n : ℕ, ∀ x : A, (ℓ ^ n) • x = 0)
    (hF : ∀ M : spFiniteConstructibleTorCategory X A,
      spFiniteConstructibleTor Y A ((reductionCompactSupport A j p).obj M.obj)) :
    ∃ (G : spFiniteConstructibleTorCategory Y A ⥤ spFiniteConstructibleTorCategory X A)
      (adj : reductionCtfCompactSupport A j p hF ⊣ G),
      Nonempty (ReductionExceptionalRealization A j p hF G adj)
